compute_psnr: compute the PSNR between two torch image tensors with optional masking
compute_ssim: compute the SSIM between two torch image tensors using a configurable window size
compute_lpips: compute the LPIPS perceptual similarity between two torch image tensors
compute_metrics: compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS metrics between predicted and ground truth tensors
compute_frame_metrics: compute frame-level metrics from dictionary-based prediction and ground truth data with key lookup
